title: Program at a Glance
summary: IEEE SSCI 2027 is planned as a three-day in-person technical program with pre-conference tutorials and workshops.

sections.heading: Technical Program Overview
paragraphs: The technical program is planned to span three full days of in-person sessions, supported by hybrid presentation capability if needed.
bullets: Poster sessions for full papers, short papers, and late-breaking abstracts
Tutorials and workshops before the main conference
Young Professionals, Women in Computational Intelligence, and other networking sessions

sections.heading: Keynotes, Panels, and Industry Participation
paragraphs: The conference plans to host distinguished keynote speakers from academia and industry addressing emerging frontiers in computational intelligence. Industry and academic panels will focus on application domains such as healthcare AI, financial AI, energy and transport sustainability, and trustworthy computational intelligence.

A dedicated technology demo and industry exhibition zone is planned alongside the technical program. Industry panels and poster/demo sessions will invite participation from industry, startups, and applied labs.

sections.heading: Award Ceremony
paragraphs: Awards are planned to be presented during the conference banquet to recognize excellence and encourage participation.
